review.notes: All 39 physical pages' extracted text was swept line-by-line against the OCR markdown (normalized), with fence balance checked across the whole file (no code fences, no spurious headings; tables render as intact HTML tables). All unmatched lines were resolved: nine footnote bodies that exist in the PDF page footers are missing from the OCR markdown (the known Anthropic class; the text layer here is clean of U+200B inside the footnote bodies), plus one dropped-letter misread (sycophancy). Each footnote body was transcribed and visually confirmed on 150-dpi renders of the page bottom; the misread was confirmed on a 300-dpi render of physical p.23. The leading ANTHROP\C logo-wordmark line above the H1 was left unchanged, matching the accepted state of the Claude Opus 4.5 system card reader. Remaining unmatched PDF lines are cover-art branding (anthropic.com) and table reading-order artifacts whose values are present in the exported tables.
